$comment: The one list of SpecWeave skills. Core skills ship in the sw plugin and in every project. Optional skills install into a project only when listed under skills.enabled in .specweave/config.json, or when their detect rule matches and they are not under skills.disabled. Retired skills are removed from projects on update. scripts/build/generate-skills.mjs copies this file to plugins/specweave/skills-catalog.json.
